L17·N6346unmasked layer
Low-specificity neuron that fires on a short function word or label token sitting immediately before an upcoming specifier (a numeral/year, adjective, or direction) — e.g. "to" in "Go to right", "Level" before "2", the space before "2011", "the" before "new SUV", "that" before "students"; it's a structural pre-modifier slot rather than a semantic concept.
